title: Unlimited OCR Works 2
abstract: arXiv:2610.39308v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Unlimited OCR ushers the era of long-horizon parsing, substantially mitigating the growth of working memory as document lengthens. However, as document length scales to hundreds of pages, the visual context grows substantially, sharply increasing the computational cost of each decoding step and limiting the scalability of ultra-long document parsing. Inspired by human book transcription via localized focus without re-scanning preceding pages, we introduce Unlimited OCR 2, a document parsing model that looks only at what it transcribes. Building on Unlimited OCR, we upgrade all the decoder attention modules to Sparse Reference Sliding Window Attention (SR-SWA), bounding active reference tokens to a fixed capacity and thus sustaining constant computational costs across arbitrarily long documents. translated_abstract: Unlimited OCR（无限OCR）开启了长程解析的时代，在文档长度增加时显著缓解了工作记忆的增长。然而，当文档长度扩展至数百页时，视觉上下文会大幅增长，急剧增加每个解码步骤的计算成本，从而限制了超长文档解析的可扩展性。受人类通过局部聚焦、无需重新扫描前文页面即可转录书籍的启发，我们提出了 Unlimited OCR 2，一个只关注其正在转录内容的文档解析模型。在 Unlimited OCR 的基础上，我们将所有解码器注意力模块升级为稀疏参考滑动窗口注意力，将活跃参考令牌的数量限制在固定容量内，从而在任意长度的文档上保持恒定的计算成本。通过将 SR-SWA 与无限视界解码范式相结合，Unlimited OCR 2 能够对几乎无限长度的文档进行解析，而……
tldr: 通过将全部解码器注意力模块升级为稀疏参考滑动窗口注意力（SR-SWA），Unlimited OCR 2 将活跃参考令牌限制在固定容量内，实现了对任意超长文档以恒定计算成本进行解析。
en_tdlr: Unlimited OCR 2 upgrades all decoder attention modules to Sparse Reference Sliding Window Attention (SR-SWA), bounding active reference tokens to a fixed capacity so that ultra-long document parsing sustains constant computational cost at virtually unlimited lengths.
